_comment: Hand bit texts for 04887050/51 (family A): the option bytes and EquipmentFlags, read from the routines that test or set each bit. The layout of these bytes differs from 05293190AC, so the reference texts do not apply.

Options031D.0: hardware variant bit (HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck3, SparkEventCalc, StartInjectorPulse, KnockSample, QspiOutputStatus and others)
Options031D.1: hardware variant bit (HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck3, SparkEventCalc, StartInjectorPulse, IdleTargetControl, SpeedCtlControl and others)
Options031D.2: hardware variant bit (HardwareCheck, Isr_GPT_IC1, FinishFuelPulse, MisfireSegmentTime, QspiOutputStatus)
Options031D.3: hardware variant bit (HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck2, SparkEventCalc, FinishFuelPulse, RefPeriodUpdate, IdleTargetControl and others)
Options031D.4: hardware variant bit (HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck2, SparkEventCalc, FinishFuelPulse, RefPeriodUpdate, KnockSample)
Options031D.5: hardware set-up variant (Reset, HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck; also SparkEventCalc, FinishFuelPulse, KnockSample)
Options031D.6: hardware set-up variant (Reset, HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck; also SparkEventCalc, FinishFuelPulse, KnockSample)
Options031D.7: engine/ignition variant (HardwareCheck, SparkEventCalc, StartInjectorPulse, KnockSample, InjectorFuelAccount)

Options031E.2: A/C pressure sensor variant: idle A/C steps, clutch, cut and fan (AcClutchSpark, AcCutLogic, EquipmentDetect, IacLearn, IdleTargetControl)
Options031E.4: downstream O2 sensor 1 fitted (ClosedLoopManager, O2HeaterMonitor, O2UpdateDownstream)
Options031E.5: downstream O2 sensor 2 fitted (ClosedLoopManager, O2HeaterMonitor, O2DownResponseMonitor, O2UpdateDownstream)
Options031E.6: upstream O2 sensor 2 fitted, second bank (ClosedLoopManager, FuelSysTooRich2Monitor, FuelSysTooLean2Monitor, PurgeVaporLearn and others)
Options031E.7: upstream O2 sensor 1 fitted (ClosedLoopManager, FuelSysTooRich1Monitor, FuelSysTooLean1Monitor, O2HeaterMonitor, PurgeCellTrimFilter)

Options0321.5: transmission-related variant (GearStateUpdate, TccMonitor, SpeedCtlShift, IdleRpmTarget, AcCutControl, CcdTransmit and others)

Options0323.0: part-throttle fuel: MAP is held at the first x point of PartThrottleMapScale as a minimum (CalcFuelPulse)
Options0323.2: surge control on (SurgeControl); set in 04887051 (manual), clear in 04887050
Options0323.5: closed loop off: the O2 control and learning are skipped (ClosedLoopMain, O2LearnEnable, O2UpdateUpstream, PurgeVaporLearn, FuelCorrections)
Options0323.6: spark/dwell variant (CalcSpark, DwellCalc, Isr_GPT_OC2, CalcEngineRpm, OcOutputsReset, Reset)
Options0323.7: per-event spark on (EventSparkControl, EventCorrections); also the cam signal handling (Isr_GPT_IC4OC5); set in 04887050 (automatic)

Options0324.0: flex fuel on: ethanol content, flex factors and flex spark are used (FuelCorrections, FlexSensorCheck, FlexSparkCalc, O2FlexOffset and others)
Options0324.2: speed control switch variant; also used by EquipmentDetect
Options0324.6: selects a branch in GearStateUpdate; set in 04887050 (automatic)

Options0325.2: alternative purge duty table (PurgeRampControl, with bit 3)
Options0325.3: alternative purge duty table (PurgeRampControl, with bit 2)
Options0325.5: manual transmission: the gear state, park/neutral and automatic-only paths are skipped (GearStateUpdate, PnSwitchMonitor, IdleRpmTarget and others); set in 04887051
Options0325.6: EGR monitor variant: EgrMonTest runs only with it, and EgrFlowReport, EgrSparkCalc and FuelCorrections add EGR fault checks (EgrFlowMonitor, ObdRequest and others); clear in 04887050/51

Options0326.7: idle flare check off (IdleFlareCheck skips when set)

Options032B.4: closed-loop temperature (coolant warm-up) monitor on (CoolantWarmupMonitor, P0125)
Options032B.6: park/neutral switch monitor on (PnSwitchMonitor, PnSwitchMonitor2); set in 04887050 (automatic)

EquipmentFlags.5: speed control fitted: set by EquipmentDetect once the speed control switch inputs were seen, or by EquipmentProbe when the probed input answers
EquipmentFlags.6: A/C fitted: set by EquipmentDetect once an A/C request was seen (AcPresentCounter)
EquipmentFlags.7: power steering pressure switch fitted: set by EquipmentDetect once the switch input was seen (PspPresentCounter); used by the idle code and PspSwitchMonitor
